inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Thanks for letting me know the fan is still running.' The customer only reported a faint scraping/ticking noise and said they were not sure it was a proper whirr.

rationale: The assistant took sensible simple steps in order and escalated to an engineer without recommending any part, which is reasonable. But it misstated the customer's evidence by saying the fan is 'still running', when the customer only described a faint scraping/ticking and was unsure it was a whirr. It never asked about frost on the freezer back panel, never asked for the model number, and never suggested a 24h manual defrost as a test or temporary fix. It also never mentioned the scraping noise as a possible sign of an iced fan. The early advice to wait a day for recovery was unhelpful, since the customer had already said the problem had been building for a week. The final message did correctly point to an iced-up channel or a fan fault and gave a reasonable engineer referral and food-safety advice.
